harrat-mujtaba:2-2.t: «كتاب»: the khabar (predicate) of a concealed mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "this is a Book". The fāʾ in «فلا يكن» is parenthetical, and the clause is parenthetical between the preposition and what it is attached to, because «لتنذر» is a maṣdar (verbal noun) genitive by the lām, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أنزل». His words «ذكرى»: a noun conjoined to the genitive maṣdar; the implied form is: "for warning and reminding".

harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: The preposition «من دونه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «أولياء». His words «قليلا»: stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and «ما» is redundant (zāʾida). The clause «تذكَّرون» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: The wāw is resumptive; «كم» is the declarative kam (khabariyya), mubtadaʾ (subject), and the preposition is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «كم». The clause «أهلكناها» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ «كم». «بياتا» is a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "passing the night". The clause «هم قائلون» is conjoined to the single word «بياتا», in the position of the accusative, as a case of conjoining a clause to a single word; the implied form is: "passing the night or taking the midday rest".

harrat-mujtaba:5-5.t: «دعواهم»: the khabar (predicate) of kāna placed first, and its noun is the interpreted maṣdar «أن قالوا», because the interpreted maṣdar is more definite than the muḍāf; the masculine form of the verb «كان» is a supporting indication for attributing the verb to the interpreted maṣdar. His words «إذ»: an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) the maṣdar «دعواهم». The clause «فما كان دعواهم» is conjoined to the clause «كم من قرية أهلكناها», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:6-6.t: (فلنسألن الذين أرسل إليهم) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The fāʾ is resumptive, and the lām occurs in the answer to the oath; the verb is imperfect, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, the nūn is for emphasis, and the fāʿil (agent) is the pronoun "we". The clause «فلنسألن الذين» is resumptive, and «نسألنَّ» is conjoined to the answer to the oath.

harrat-mujtaba:7-7.t: The preposition «بعلم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «نقصَّنَّ», i.e. "involved in knowledge". The clause «وما كنَّا» is conjoined to the omitted ḥāl to which the preposition «بعلم» is attached, as a case of conjoining a clause to a single word, in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:8-8.t: The wāw is resumptive; «والوزن» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is «الحق». «يومئذ» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الوزن»; «إذٍ» is an adverbial noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the tanwīn compensates for a clause. The clause «فمن ثقلت» is conjoined to the first resumptive clause, and the clause «ثقلت» is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ «من».

harrat-mujtaba:9-9.t: The clause «فأولئك الذين» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), in the position of the jussive. His words «بما كانوا»: «ما» is maṣdariyya, and the genitive interpreted maṣdar is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خسروا».

harrat-mujtaba:10-10.t: «قليلا»: stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); «ما» is redundant (zāʾida), and the clause «تشكرون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:11-11.t: The clause «ولقد خلقناكم» is conjoined to the clause «ولقد مكنَّاكم», with no grammatical position. «إبليس» is excepted, and the clause «لم يكن» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:12-12.t: «ما»: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «منعك» is the khabar (predicate). «ألا تسجد»: «لا» is redundant (zāʾida), for emphasis, and the interpreted maṣdar is accusative by removal of the preposition «مِنْ». «إذ» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) تسجد. The preposition «منه» is attached to «خير». The clause «خلقتني» explains the superiority.

harrat-mujtaba:13-13.t: The fāʾ in «فاهبط» is [for] the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied (muqaddar) condition, i.e. "if you refuse to obey Me, then descend". The clause «فما يكون» is conjoined to the clause «اهبط», and the interpreted maṣdar «أن تتكبر» is the fāʿil (agent) of the complete (tāmma) «يكون»; the preposition «لك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يكون». The clause «إنك من الصاغرين» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:14-14.t: The clause «يبعثون» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

harrat-mujtaba:16-16.t: The clause «فبما أغويتني» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied (muqaddar) condition, i.e. "if You grant me respite". The bāʾ is a preposition conveying causation; «ما» is maṣdariyya, and the interpreted maṣdar is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أقعدن». The implied form is: "if You grant me respite, then I shall surely sit in wait for them because of Your leading me astray". The clause «فوالله لأقعدنَّ» is the apodosis of the implied condition. «صراطك» is accusative by removal of the preposition «على»; parsing it as an adverb is weak, because it is specific (mukhtaṣṣ), and the specific is reached with «في», as in: «صليت في المسجد».

harrat-mujtaba:17-17.t: The clause «ولا تجد» is conjoined to the clause «لآتينهم», with no grammatical position; the nūn of emphasis was not joined to it although it is conjoined to the answer to the oath, because it is negated.

harrat-mujtaba:18-18.t: «مذءومًا»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «اخرج», and likewise «مدحورا»; multiple ḥāls for a single possessor of the ḥāl are permitted. The lām in his words «لمَن» prepares for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam), and «مَن» is conditional, mubtadaʾ (subject). The preposition «منهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl from the latent (mustatir) pronoun in «تبعك», i.e. "being from them". The clause «لمن تبعك» is resumptive, and «أجمعين» is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the attached pronoun in «منكم».

harrat-mujtaba:19-19.t: «أنت»: a tawkīd (emphasis) of the latent (mustatir) pronoun in «اسكن». His words «وزوجك»: a noun conjoined to the latent pronoun in «اسكن». «حيث» is an adverbial noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, in the position of the genitive [Translator's note: so in the source], attached to (mutaʿalliq) «كلا», and the clause «شئتما» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). His words «فتكونا»: the fāʾ is causal, and the verb is an imperfect abrogating verb (nāsikh), accusative by a concealed أن after the fāʾ; the sign of its accusative is the dropping of the nūn, and the alif is the fāʿil (agent). The interpreted maṣdar is conjoined to a maṣdar extracted from the preceding speech, i.e. "let there be no approaching from you two, and so the occurrence of wrongdoing from you two".

harrat-mujtaba:20-20.t: «ما ووري عنهما»: «ما» is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and a past verb, passive, whose nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is the pronoun "it"; the preposition «عنهما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb, and the second preposition is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the latent (mustatir) pronoun in «ووري». The interpreted maṣdar «أن تكونا» is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. "for fear that you two become".

harrat-mujtaba:21-21.t: The preposition «لكما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «الناصحين», and the preposition «لمن الناصحين» is attached to the khabar (predicate); [the lām is] the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa). The clause «إني لمن الناصحين» is the answer to the oath, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:22-22.t: The preposition «بغرور» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the agent pronoun, i.e. "he lowered them both, involved in deception". His words «وطفقا يخصفان»: the wāw is a conjunction, and a past abrogating verb (nāsikh) whose noun is the pronoun; the clause «يخصفان» is in the position of the accusative as its khabar (predicate). The clause «ألم أنهكما» explains the calling, with no grammatical position. The preposition «لكما» is attached to «عدو».

harrat-mujtaba:23-23.t: The clause «لنكونن» is the answer to an implied (muqaddar) oath; before the conditional particle the preparatory lām (lām al-tawṭiʾa) is implied, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) has been omitted. The preposition «من الخاسرين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of kāna.

harrat-mujtaba:24-24.t: The clause «بعضكم لبعض عدو» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in «اهبطوا», in the position of the accusative. The preposition «في الأرض» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl from «مستقر», the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the preposition «إلى حين» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «متاع». The clause «ولكم في الأرض مستقر» is conjoined to the clause «بعضكم عدو».

harrat-mujtaba:26-26.t: The clause «قد أنزلنا» is the answer to the vocative, resumptive; the clause «يواري» is a naʿt (adjective) of «لباسا». The clause «ولباس التقوى ذلك خير» is conjoined to the answer to the vocative, with no grammatical position, and the clause «ذلك خير» is the khabar (predicate) of «لباس»; the pointing to the mubtadaʾ (subject) dispensed with the link between the mubtadaʾ and the khabar. The clause «لعلهم يذكَّرون» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:27-27.t: His words «كما أخرج»: the kāf stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and «ما» is maṣdariyya, i.e. "a tempting like the tempting of bringing out"; the interpreted maṣdar is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause «ينزع» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun of «أخرج». The clause «إنه يراكم» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. «هو» is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the pronoun hāʾ in «إنه» [Translator's note: so in the source], and this separator is what permits conjoining «وقبيله» to the latent (mustatir) pronoun in «يراكم». The clause «لا ترونهم» is muḍāf ilayhi.

harrat-mujtaba:28-28.t: The conditional clause is conjoined to the ṣila (relative clause) {لا يُؤْمِنُونَ}. The clause «والله أمرنا» is conjoined to the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl).

harrat-mujtaba:29-29.t: The clause «أقيموا» is conjoined to the implied (muqaddar) command into which the maṣdar (verbal noun) resolves, namely «بالقسط», i.e. "say: my Lord has commanded that you be just and that you set". «مخلصين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «ادعوه», and «الدين» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «مخلصين». The kāf in «كما» stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "you will return with a returning like your beginning", and «ما» is maṣdariyya. The clause «تعودون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:30-30.t: «فريقا»: a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) placed first, and the second «فريقا» is the mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb explained by what follows it, i.e. "and He sent astray a party"; the clause «حقَّ» explains the implied one. The preposition «من دون» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أولياء». The interpreted maṣdar «أنهم مهتدون» takes the place of the two objects of «حسب».

harrat-mujtaba:32-32.t: The preposition «من الرزق» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الطيبات», and «خالصة» is a ḥāl from «الطيبات». The kāf in «كذلك» stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "We detail the signs with a detailing like that detailing". The clause «نفصل» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:33-33.t: «ما ظهر»: a relative noun, a badal (substitute) of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) from «الفواحش». The preposition «بغير» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «البغي», and the interpreted maṣdar «أن تشركوا» is conjoined to «البغي».

harrat-mujtaba:34-34.t: The conditional clause is conjoined to the resumptive clause at the start of the verse; the consequent of the condition is the two clauses together, not each one separately. «ساعة» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb.

harrat-mujtaba:35-35.t: His words «إما يأتينكم»: «إن» is conditional and «ما» is redundant (zāʾida); the imperfect verb is indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa because it is attached to the nūn of emphasis, in the position of the jussive. The clause «يقصُّون» is a naʿt (adjective) of رسل. His words «فمن اتقى»: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of the condition إما, and «من» is a second conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause «فلا خوف عليهم» is the apodosis of the second condition, and the second conditional clause is the apodosis of the first condition. «لا» in «فلا خوف» operates like laysa, whereas the second «لا» in «ولا هم» is inoperative, because it enters upon a definite noun.

harrat-mujtaba:36-36.t: The clause «أولئك أصحاب» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «الذين»; its lacking the link is permitted because of the pointing to the mubtadaʾ. The clause «هم فيها خالدون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «أصحاب», and the preposition is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خالدون».

harrat-mujtaba:37-37.t: «حتى» is inceptive (ibtidāʾiyya), and «إذا» is adverbial and conditional, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قالوا»; the conditional clause is resumptive. «أين» is an interrogative noun, an adverb of place attached to the omitted khabar (predicate); «ما» is a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the preposition «من دون» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the implied (muqaddar) referring pronoun. The interpreted maṣdar «أنهم كانوا» is accusative by removal of the preposition, the bāʾ.

harrat-mujtaba:38-38.t: His words «خلت»: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on a fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif dropped because of the meeting of two vowelless letters. The preposition «من الجن» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of أمم, and the preposition «في النار» is attached to «ادخلوا». Attaching two prepositions — ادخلوا في أمم في النار — with the same wording to a single governor is permitted because the meanings of the two particles differ: the first means "with" and the second is locative. «كلما»: «كل» is an adverb of time attached to «لعنت», and «ما» is temporal maṣdariyya, the interpreted maṣdar being muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the implied form is: "a nation cursed its sister at every time of entering". The clause «دخلت» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative, and the clause «لعنت» is a second naʿt of «أمم»; the link between the naʿt and the noun it qualifies is implied, i.e. "of them". His words «ضعفا»: a naʿt of «عذابا». The clause «ولكن لا تعلمون» is conjoined to the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl), in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:39-39.t: The fāʾ in «فما كان» occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied (muqaddar) condition, i.e. "if you went astray because of us, then there was not". «فضل» is the noun of kāna, «مِن» is redundant (zāʾida), and the preposition «علينا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «فضل». The clause «فذوقوا» is conjoined to the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl), and the relative «بما كانوا» is genitive, attached to «ذوقوا».

harrat-mujtaba:40-40.t: The clause «نجزي» is resumptive, and the kāf stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "We recompense with a recompense like that recompense".

harrat-mujtaba:41-41.t: «غواشٍ»: a mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative with a ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the dropped yāʾ. The clause «لهم من جهنم مهاد» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «المجرمين». The clause «نجزي» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:42-42.t: The clause «لا نكلِّف نفسا» is parenthetical; the clause «أولئك أصحاب الجنة» is the khabar (predicate) of «الذين», and the clause «هم فيها خالدون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «أصحاب».

harrat-mujtaba:43-43.t: The preposition «من غل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the referring pronoun in the ṣila (relative clause) implied (muqaddar) as استقر. The lām in «لنهتدي» is the lām of denial (lām al-juḥūd), and the interpreted maṣdar is genitive, attached to the implied khabar (predicate) of kāna, i.e. "intending guidance". The interpreted maṣdar «أنْ هدانا الله» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar is omitted, its implied form being "existing"; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e. "had it not been for Allah's guidance we would not have been guided". The clause «لولا أن هدانا» together with its implied apodosis is resumptive. His words «أن تلكم»: «أن» is explicative, «تلكم» is a mubtadaʾ, and «الجنة» is a badal (substitute); the clause «تلكم الجنة أورثتموها» is explicative, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:44-44.t: His words «أن قد وجدنا»: «أن» is explicative, and the clause «وجدنا» is explicative; «حقا» is a second object. «أن لعنة الله»: «أن» is explicative and «لعنة» is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause «لعنة الله على الظالمين» is explicative.

harrat-mujtaba:45-45.t: «الذين يصدون»: a naʿt (adjective) of «الظالمين». «عِوَجا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw. The clause «وهم كافرون» is conjoined to the clause «يبغونها», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:46-46.t: The clause «وبينهما حجاب» is resumptive, and the clause «وعلى الأعراف رجال» is conjoined to the resumptive clause. «أن سلام عليكم»: «أن» is explicative and «سلام» is a mubtadaʾ (subject); beginning with an indefinite noun is permitted because it is a supplication. The clause «سلام عليكم» explains the calling. The clause «لم يدخلوها» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «نادوا», and likewise the clause «وهم يطمعون» is a ḥāl from the fāʿil of «يدخلوها».

harrat-mujtaba:47-47.t: «تلقاء»: an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) «صُرِفت». «مع» is an adverb of place for accompaniment, attached to the verb «تجعلنا».

harrat-mujtaba:48-48.t: «ما أغنى»: «ما» is negating, and «أغنى» is a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is «جَمْعُكم»; the interpreted maṣdar «ما كنتم» is conjoined to «جمعكم», the implied form being: "your gathering and your being arrogant".

harrat-mujtaba:49-49.t: The clause «لا ينالهم» is the answer to the oath, with no grammatical position; emphasising it with the nūn is precluded because it is negated. The clause «ادخلوا» is the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl) of an omitted saying, i.e. "so Allah said to them: enter". The omitted clause of saying is resumptive. The clause «لا خوف عليكم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in «ادخلوا».

harrat-mujtaba:50-50.t: (أن أفيضوا علينا من الماء) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] «أن» is explicative. The clause «أفيضوا» is explicative, explaining the calling. The clause «قالوا» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:51-51.t: The clause «فاليوم ننساهم» is resumptive; the kāf stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and «ما» is maṣdariyya, i.e. "We forget them with a forgetting like their forgetting". «لقاء» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the interpreted maṣdar «وما كانوا» is conjoined to the preceding interpreted maṣdar.

harrat-mujtaba:52-52.t: The preposition «على علم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent). «هُدى» is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). The preposition «لقوم» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «رحمة».

harrat-mujtaba:53-53.t: «يوم»: an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يقول». The preposition «بالحق» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «رسل». The clause «فهل لنا من شفعاء» is conjoined to the clause «قد جاءت»; conjoining a performative (inshāʾ) to a statement (khabar) is permitted. «شفعاء» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and «مِن» is redundant (zāʾida). The fāʾ in «فيشفعوا» is causal, and the verb is accusative by أن necessarily concealed after the fāʾ of causation; the interpreted maṣdar is conjoined to «شفعاء», i.e. "do we have intercessors, and so intercession from them for us?" The fāʾ in «فنعمل» is causal, i.e. "is there a sending back, so that we may do?" «غير» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «أو نرد» is conjoined to the clause «هل لنا من شفعاء», in the position of the accusative; the meaning is: "will anyone intercede for us, or will we be sent back?"

harrat-mujtaba:54-54.t: «الذي»: a naʿt (adjective) of the Divine Name. The clause «يغشي» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «خلق», and the clause «يطلبه» is a ḥāl from «الليل». «حثيثا» stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "a seeking". «مسخرات» is a ḥāl from the preceding nouns, and the preposition is attached to (mutaʿalliq) مسخرات. «رب العالمين» is a badal (substitute), nominative. The clause «تبارك الله» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:55-55.t: «تضرُّعا»: a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of a ḥāl (circumstantial). The clause «إنه لا يحب» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:56-56.t: «بعد»: an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تفسدوا». «خوفا» is a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "possessed of fear". The preposition «من المحسنين» is attached to «قريب».

harrat-mujtaba:57-57.t: The clause «وهو الذي» is conjoined to the clause {إِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ اللَّهُ} in verse 54, and what lies between them is parenthetical. «بشرا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الرياح». «بين» is an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يرسل». «حتى» is inceptive (ibtidāʾiyya), and the clause after it is resumptive. The kāf in «كذلك» stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "We bring out the dead with a bringing-out like that bringing-out". The clause «لعلكم تذكرون» is a resumptive clause.

harrat-mujtaba:58-58.t: The preposition «بإذن» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «نباته», and «نكدا» is a ḥāl from the pronoun in «يخرج». The kāf in «كذلك» stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "We vary the signs with a varying like that varying"; the clause «نصرِّف» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. The clause «يشكرون» is a naʿt (adjective) of قوم.

harrat-mujtaba:59-59.t: The clause «ما لكم من إله غيره» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the Divine Name. «إله» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), «مِن» is redundant (zāʾida), and «غيره» is a naʿt (adjective) of the nominative position of «إله».

harrat-mujtaba:60-60.t: The preposition «في ضلال» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «نراك».

harrat-mujtaba:61-61.t: «يا قوم»: the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, accusative with a fatḥa implied (muqaddar) before the dropped yāʾ. The clause «ولكني رسول» is conjoined to the resumptive answer to the vocative, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:62-62.t: The clause «أبلغكم» is a naʿt (adjective) of {رَسُولٌ}, in the position of the nominative. The preposition «من الله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «ما».

harrat-mujtaba:63-63.t: The interpreted maṣdar «أن جاءكم» is accusative by removal of the preposition «مِنْ», and the clause «جاءكم» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative. The clause «ولعلكم ترحمون» is conjoined to the genitive maṣdar, as a case of conjoining a clause to a single word.

harrat-mujtaba:64-64.t: «والذين»: a noun conjoined to the hāʾ in «فأنجيناه». «معه»: an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied (muqaddar) ṣila (relative clause), and likewise «في الفلك» is attached. The clause «إنهم كانوا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الذين كذَّبوا», and «عمين» is a naʿt (adjective) [Translator's note: so in the source; presumably meant: khabar] — the khabar (predicate) of kāna.

harrat-mujtaba:65-65.t: The preposition «وإلى عاد» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an implied (muqaddar) أرسلنا. «أخاهم» is the object of the implied verb, accusative with alif; «هودا» is a badal (substitute) from أخاهم. «إله» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and «مِن» is redundant (zāʾida); «غيره» is a naʿt (adjective) of the position of «إله», nominative. The clause «ما لكم من إله غيره» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the Divine Name. The clause «أفلا تتقون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:66-66.t: The preposition «من قومه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the relative noun. The preposition «في سفاهة» is attached to «نراك». The preposition «من الكاذبين» is attached to the second object of «نظنك».

harrat-mujtaba:68-68.t: The clause «أبلِّغكم» is a second naʿt (adjective) of {رَسُولٌ}, and the clause «وأنا ناصح» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the latent (mustatir) pronoun in «أبلغكم». The preposition «لكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ناصح». «أمين» is a second khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:69-69.t: (أوعجبتم أن جاءكم ذكر) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The hamza is for interrogation, and the wāw is resumptive. «أن» is maṣdariyya, and the interpreted maṣdar is accusative by removal of the preposition (مِنْ). The preposition «من ربكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «ذِكْر»; the preposition «على رجل» is attached to a second naʿt; the preposition «منكم» is attached to a naʿt of «رجل». The interpreted maṣdar «لينذركم» is genitive, attached to «جاءكم». The clause «فاذكروا» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. The clause «لعلكم تفلحون» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:70-70.t: «وحده»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) interpreted as an indefinite, i.e. "alone"; the object of «يعبد» is omitted, i.e. يعبده. The clause «فأتنا» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied (muqaddar) condition, i.e. "if you are truthful, then bring us". The clause «إن كنت من الصادقين» is resumptive, and the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:71-71.t: The preposition «من ربكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «وقع». The clause «أتجادلونني» is resumptive within the scope of the speech. The clause «سميتموها» is a naʿt (adjective) of أسماء, and «أنتم» is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the pronoun tāʾ in «سميتموها»; the clause «ما نزل» is a second naʿt of أسماء. The clause «فانتظروا» is resumptive. The clause «إني معكم» is resumptive within the scope of the speech. The preposition «من المنتظرين» is attached to the khabar (predicate), and «معكم» is an adverb attached to المنتظرين.

harrat-mujtaba:72-72.t: «فأنجيناه والذين»: the fāʾ conjoins to an implied (muqaddar) resumptive clause, i.e. "so We punished them, and We saved him". His words «والذين»: a noun conjoined to the hāʾ in «أنجيناه». The clause «وما كانوا» is conjoined to the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:73-73.t: The preposition «وإلى ثمود» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an implied (muqaddar) أرسلنا. «أخاهم» is the object of the implied verb, accusative with alif, and «صالحا» is a badal (substitute) from «أخاهم», accusative with fatḥa. «إله» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), «مِن» is redundant (zāʾida), and «غيره» is a naʿt (adjective) of إله according to its position. The clause «ما لكم من إله غيره» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الله». The clause «قد جاءكم» is resumptive within the scope of the speech. «لكم آية»: the preposition is attached to an omitted ḥāl from «آية», and «آية» is a ḥāl from «ناقة الله». The clause «فذروها» is conjoined to the clause «هذه ناقة», with no grammatical position. The fāʾ in «فيأخذكم» is causal, and the interpreted maṣdar is conjoined to a maṣdar extracted from the preceding speech, i.e. "let there be no touching from you, and so a seizing". The clause «تأكل» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of the implied condition. The clause «ولا تمسوها» is conjoined to the clause «فذروها».

harrat-mujtaba:74-74.t: «إذ»: an adverbial noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «تتخذون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the kāf in «بَوَّأَكم». «بيوتا» is a ḥāl from «الجبال», and «مفسدين» is a ḥāl from the wāw. The clause «فاذكروا» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:75-75.t: «لمن آمن»: this preposition phrase is a badal (substitute) from «للذين», attached to (mutaʿalliq) what it is attached to. The interpreted maṣdar «أن صالحا مرسل» takes the place of the two objects of علم. The preposition «من ربه» is attached to «مرسل».

harrat-mujtaba:76-76.t: The preposition «بالذي» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «كافرون», which is the khabar (predicate) of «إن».

harrat-mujtaba:77-77.t: The clause «فعقروا» is resumptive. The clause «إن كنت» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:79-79.t: The clause «لقد أبلغتكم» is the answer to an oath, and the oath clause with its answer is the answer to the vocative, resumptive. The clause «ولكن لا تحبون» is conjoined to the clause «نصحت».

harrat-mujtaba:80-80.t: His words «ولوطا»: the wāw is resumptive, and «لوطا» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an implied (muqaddar) اذكر; «إذ» is an adverbial noun, a badal (substitute) from «لوطا». «أحد» is the fāʿil (agent) and «من» is redundant (zāʾida); the preposition «من العالمين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of أحد. The clause «ما سبقكم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of «تأتون», i.e. "you commit it without being preceded".

harrat-mujtaba:81-81.t: «شهوة»: a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). The preposition «من دون» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الرجال», i.e. "passing over".

harrat-mujtaba:82-82.t: The interpreted maṣdar «أن قالوا» is the noun of kāna. The clause «إنهم أناس» is resumptive within the scope of the speech, and the clause «يتطهرون» is a naʿt (adjective) of «أناس».

harrat-mujtaba:83-83.t: The clause «فأنجيناه»: the fāʾ conjoins to an implied (muqaddar) resumptive clause, i.e. "they intended evil for him, so We saved him". «أهله» is a noun conjoined to the pronoun hāʾ, and «امرأته» is excepted, accusative. The clause «كانت من الغابرين» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:84-84.t: «مطرا»: a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). «كيف» is an interrogative noun, the khabar (predicate) of kāna, and the clause «كان» is the mafʿūl bihi of the verb «انظر», which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative and made to imply (taḍmīn) the meaning of knowing.

harrat-mujtaba:85-85.t: His words «وإلى مدين»: the wāw is a conjunction, and the preposition is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an implied (muqaddar) أرسلنا. «أخاهم» is the object of the implied أرسلنا, and «شعيبا» is a badal (substitute). The clause «ما لكم من إله غيره» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the Divine Name; «إله» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), «مِن» is redundant (zāʾida), and «غيره» is a naʿt (adjective) according to the position of «إله». The clause «قد جاءتكم» is resumptive. The clause «فأوفوا» is conjoined to the clause «جاءتكم». «بخس» takes two objects: «الناس» and «أشياءهم». The clause «إن كنتم مؤمنين» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:86-86.t: The clause «توعدون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in «تقعدوا», in the position of the accusative. «عِوَجا» is a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of a ḥāl, and «إذ» is an adverbial noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «كان عاقبة» is the object of the looking, which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative, and «كيف» is an interrogative noun, the khabar (predicate) of kāna.

harrat-mujtaba:87-87.t: (وإن كان طائفة منكم آمنوا) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The noun of kāna may be indefinite because it is qualified. His words «وطائفة»: a noun conjoined to «طائفة». The clause «لم يؤمنوا» is conjoined to «آمنوا», which is the khabar (predicate) of kāna, and what it is attached to is omitted, i.e. "they did not believe in that with which I was sent"; a noun is conjoined to a noun and a khabar to a khabar. The clause «وهو خير الحاكمين» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:88-88.t: The clause «لنخرجنّك يا شعيب» is the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl); the clause «لنخرجنك» is the answer to the oath, and the clause «يا شعيب» is parenthetical. His words «والذين»: a noun conjoined to the kāf. His words «لتعودن»: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the presence of the nūn, which was dropped because of the succession of like letters; the implied wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and the nūn is for emphasis. The clause «لتعودُنَّ» is conjoined to the preceding answer to the oath. His words «أولو كنا»: the hamza is for interrogation, and the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), conjoining to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the implied form is: "will you expel us in every state, even in this state?" This is for exhausting all the states. The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e. "even if we were unwilling, you would expel us"; the clause that is the content of the speech is omitted, i.e. "will you expel us?"

harrat-mujtaba:89-89.t: The clause «إن عدنا» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. «إذ»: an adverbial noun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The interpreted maṣdar «أن نعود» is the noun of يكون, and the preposition «لنا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate). The clause «وما يكون لنا أن نعود» is conjoined to the clause «قد افترينا». The interpreted maṣdar «أن يشاء» is excepted, connected (muttaṣil), from the general states, i.e. "it is not for us to return to it in any state except the state of Allah the Exalted willing". «علما» is a tamyīz (specification). The clause «وأنت خير الفاتحين» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:90-90.t: The clause «إنكم لخاسرون» is the answer to the oath, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:92-92.t: (الذين كذبوا شعيبا كأن لم يغنوا فيها) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The relative noun is a mubtadaʾ (subject); «كأنْ» is a lightened abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and its noun is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn). The clause «الذين كذبوا ...» is parenthetical between the two conjoined elements, namely «أصبحوا جاثمين» and «فتولى عنهم»; the second clause «الذين كذبوا» is resumptive within the parenthesis. The khabar (predicate) of the first «الذين» is the clause «كأن لم يغنوا», and the clause «كانوا هم الخاسرين» is the khabar of the second الذين.

harrat-mujtaba:93-93.t: The clause «لقد أبلغتكم» is the answer to the oath, and the oath clause with its answer is the answer to the vocative, resumptive. The clause «فكيف آسى» is conjoined to the clause «أبلغتكم», with no grammatical position, and «كيف» is an interrogative noun, a ḥāl (circumstantial).

harrat-mujtaba:94-94.t: The clause «أخذنا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in «أرسلنا»; a past verb may occur after «إلا» because a verb precedes it. The clause «لعلهم يَضَّرَّعون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:95-95.t: «مكان»: a second object placed first, and «الحسنة» is the first object. «بغتة» is a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of a ḥāl (circumstantial). The clause «وهم لا يشعرون» is a ḥāl from the pronoun «نا» in «أخذناهم».

harrat-mujtaba:96-96.t: (ولو أن أهل القرى آمنوا) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The interpreted maṣdar is the fāʿil (agent) of an implied (muqaddar) «ثبت», i.e. "if the belief of the people of the towns were established". The clause «ولكن كذَّبوا» is conjoined to the clause «آمنوا», in the position of the nominative.

harrat-mujtaba:97-97.t: The interpreted maṣdar «أن يأتيهم» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «بياتا» is an adverb of time. The clause «وهم نائمون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

harrat-mujtaba:98-98.t: The interpreted maṣdar «أن يأتيهم» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «ضُحى» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يأتيهم».

harrat-mujtaba:99-99.t: The clause «فلا يأمن» is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and «القوم» is the fāʿil (agent).

harrat-mujtaba:100-100.t: «أنْ»: lightened from the heavy (inna), and its noun is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn); the conditional clause is the khabar (predicate) of «أنْ», and the interpreted maṣdar is the fāʿil (agent) of «يهد». The clause «ونطبع» is resumptive, and the clause «فهم لا يسمعون» is conjoined to the clause «ونطبع».

harrat-mujtaba:101-101.t: «تلك القرى»: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate). The clause «نَقُصُّ» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «القرى». The clause «فما كانوا» is conjoined to the clause «جاءتهم»; the lām in «ليؤمنوا» is the lām of denial (lām al-juḥūd), and the interpreted maṣdar is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar of kāna, i.e. "they were not intending to believe". The clause «يطبع» is parenthetical between the two conjoined elements, and the kāf stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "Allah seals with a sealing like that sealing".

harrat-mujtaba:102-102.t: The clause «وما وجدنا» is conjoined to the clause «فما كانوا». «عهد» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), «من» is redundant (zāʾida), and the preposition «لأكثرهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «عهد». The lām in «لفاسقين» is the distinguishing lām (al-fāriqa) between the lightened (inna) and the negating (in); «إنْ» is inoperative, and «فاسقين» is a second object.

harrat-mujtaba:103-103.t: The clause «كان» is the object of the looking, which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative that implies the meaning of knowing, and «كيف» is an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as the khabar (predicate) of kāna.

harrat-mujtaba:105-105.t: «حقيق»: a second khabar (predicate) of «إن» in the previous verse, and it means "eager"; the interpreted maṣdar is genitive by «على», attached to (mutaʿalliq) «حقيق», and «الحق» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «قد جئتكم» is a third khabar of «إن». The clause «فأرسل» is conjoined to the clause «قد جئتكم».

harrat-mujtaba:106-106.t: The clause «إن كنت» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:107-107.t: His words «فإذا»: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «إذا» is of surprise (fujāʾiyya); the clause «فإذا هي ثعبان» is conjoined to the clause «ألقى».

harrat-mujtaba:108-108.t: «إذا» is of surprise (fujāʾiyya), and the clause «فإذا هي بيضاء» is conjoined to the clause «نزع». The preposition «للناظرين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a second khabar (predicate), i.e. "manifest to the onlookers".

harrat-mujtaba:109-109.t: The preposition «من قوم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الملأ». «عليم» is a second khabar (predicate) of «إنَّ».

harrat-mujtaba:110-110.t: The clause «يريد» is a third khabar (predicate) of «إن». The clause «فماذا تأمرون» is the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl) of an omitted saying, i.e. "so Pharaoh said: what then do you command?"; the implied clause of saying is resumptive. «ما» is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and «ذا» is a relative noun, its khabar.

harrat-mujtaba:111-111.t: His words «أرجه»: from أَرْجَيْته, when you have postponed it; it is an imperative, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter; the fāʿil (agent) is the pronoun "you", and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); giving the pronoun hāʾ a sukūn is a dialect usage. «أخاه» is conjoined to the hāʾ in «أرجه», accusative with alif. «حاشرين» is a mafʿūl bihi; the original is "men who gather", and the object of «حاشرين» is omitted, i.e. "the sorcerers".

harrat-mujtaba:112-112.t: «يأتوك»: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied (muqaddar) condition; the sign of its being jussive is the dropping of the nūn.

harrat-mujtaba:113-113.t: The clause «قالوا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the sorcerers. «إن» is conditional, and «نحن» is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the pronoun «نا». The clause «إن كنا نحن الغالبين» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:114-114.t: The clause «نعم» is the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl) together with its implied (muqaddar) statement, i.e. "yes, you will be rewarded". The clause «وإنكم لمن المقربين» is conjoined to the implied content of the speech.

harrat-mujtaba:115-115.t: (إما أن تلقي وإما أن نكون نحن الملقين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] «إما» is a particle of choice; the interpreted maṣdar is the object of an implied (muqaddar) verb, its implied form being: "choose". «نحن» is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the latent (mustatir) pronoun in «نكون».

harrat-mujtaba:116-116.t: The clause «فلما ألقوا» is conjoined to the clause «قال», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:117-117.t: (أن ألق عصاك فإذا هي تلقف) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] «أن» is explicative, and the clause «ألق» is explicative. The fāʾ in «فإذا» is a conjunction, and «إذا» is of surprise (fujāʾiyya); the clause «فإذا هي تلقف» is conjoined to an implied (muqaddar) «ألقاها», and the implied clause is conjoined to the clause «أوحينا», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:118-118.t: The clause «فوقع الحق» is conjoined to the clause «هي تلقف». «ما» is a relative noun, fāʿil (agent).

harrat-mujtaba:119-119.t: «هنالك»: a demonstrative, an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) «غلبوا»; the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address. «صاغرين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in «غلبوا».

harrat-mujtaba:121-121.t: The clause «قالوا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the latent (mustatir) pronoun in {سَاجِدِينَ}.

harrat-mujtaba:123-123.t: The interpreted maṣdar «أن آذن» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause «مكرتموه» is a naʿt (adjective) of «مكر», and the wāw in «مكرتموه» is for lengthening (ishbāʿ). The clause «فسوف تعلمون» is resumptive within the scope of the speech.

harrat-mujtaba:124-124.t: The preposition «من خلاف» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an implied (muqaddar) ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hands and the feet. The oath and its answer explain the threat in his words {فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ}. «أجمعين» is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the kāf.

harrat-mujtaba:126-126.t: The interpreted maṣdar «أن آمنا» is the object of «نقم». The clause «لما جاءتنا» is resumptive within the scope of the speech, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:127-127.t: The preposition «من قوم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الملأ». «يذرك» is an imperfect verb, accusative, conjoined to «يفسدوا». The adverb «فوقهم» is attached to a second khabar (predicate) of «إنَّ». The clause «وإنا قاهرون» is conjoined to the clause «ونستحيي».

harrat-mujtaba:128-128.t: The clause «يورثها» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the Divine Name, and «مَنْ» is a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The preposition «من عباده» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl from «مَنْ». The clause «والعاقبة للمتقين» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:129-129.t: The interpreted maṣdar «أن تأتينا» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and likewise the interpreted maṣdar «ما جئتنا», because «ما» is maṣdariyya. «عسى» is incomplete (nāqiṣa), and the interpreted maṣdar «أن يهلك» is its khabar (predicate). The clause «تعلمون» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the looking, which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative and made to imply the meaning of knowing.

harrat-mujtaba:131-131.t: The conditional clause is conjoined to the clause «أخذنا». «معه» is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied (muqaddar) ṣila (relative clause). The clause «ولكن أكثرهم لا يعلمون» is conjoined to the resumptive clause «إنما طائرهم عند الله».

harrat-mujtaba:132-132.t: «مهما»: a conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the preposition «من آية» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an adjective of «مهما». The clause «فما نحن بمؤمنين» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); «ما» operates like laysa, the bāʾ in its khabar (predicate) is redundant (zāʾida), and the preposition «لك» is attached to the khabar of «ما».

harrat-mujtaba:133-133.t: «آيات»: a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative with kasra. The clause «فاستكبروا» is conjoined to the clause «أرسلنا».

harrat-mujtaba:134-134.t: The lām in «لئن» prepares for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam), and the clause «لنؤمنن» is the answer to the oath.

harrat-mujtaba:135-135.t: The fāʾ in «فلما» is a conjunction, and «لما» is a particle of necessity for necessity (ḥarf wujūb li-wujūb); the clause is conjoined to the clause «ولما وقع». The clause «هم بالغوه» is a naʿt (adjective) of «أجل». «إذا» is of surprise (fujāʾiyya), and the clause «إذا هم ينكثون» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).

harrat-mujtaba:136-136.t: The clause «فانتقمنا» is conjoined to the clause {فَلَمَّا كَشَفْنَا}. The interpreted maṣdar «بأنهم كذَّبوا» is genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أغرقناهم».

harrat-mujtaba:137-137.t: «مشارق»: the second object of «أورثنا». «الحسنى» is a naʿt (adjective) of «كلمة»; it is an elative (afʿal al-tafḍīl) that came in the feminine because it is made definite by al-, and what is made definite by al- agrees with what precedes it. «ما» in his words «بما صبروا» is maṣdariyya, and the interpreted maṣdar is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تمت». His words «ما كان يصنع فرعون»: the noun of kāna is a pronoun whose implied form is "it", referring to the relative noun, and the hāʾ in «يصنع» is implied, i.e. يصنعه. His words «وما كانوا»: a relative noun conjoined to «ما».

harrat-mujtaba:138-138.t: The clause «يعكفون» is a naʿt (adjective) of «قوم». His words «كما لهم آلهة»: the kāf is a noun meaning "like", a naʿt of «إلها»; «ما» is maṣdariyya whose ṣila (relative clause) has been omitted, its implied form being ثبت; the preposition «لهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «آلهة», and «آلهة» is the fāʿil (agent) of an implied (muqaddar) «ثبت»; the interpreted maṣdar is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The implied form is: "make for us a god like the established existence of gods for them". The clause «ثبت لهم آلهة» is the ṣila of the particle relative.

harrat-mujtaba:139-139.t: «متبّر»: the khabar (predicate) of «إن»; «ما» is a relative noun, the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of the passive participle «مُتَبَّر», and the detached pronoun «هم» is a mubtadaʾ (subject). His words «وباطل»: a noun conjoined to «متبر», and «ما» is a relative noun, the fāʿil (agent) of the active participle. The clause «إن هؤلاء متبر» is resumptive. The clause «هم فيه» is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:140-140.t: «غير»: a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) placed before «أبغي». The verb «أبغيكم» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma, and the fāʿil (agent) is the pronoun "I"; the kāf is accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "I seek for you". «إلها» is a tamyīz (specification). The clause «وهو فضَّلكم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the Divine Name, in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:141-141.t: (وإذ أنجيناكم من آل فرعون) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The wāw is resumptive; «إذ» is an adverbial noun, the object of an implied (muqaddar) اذكر; and a past verb with its fāʿil (agent) and its object. The clause «يسومونكم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «آل فرعون», and the clause «يقتلون» explains the inflicting. The clause «وفي ذلكم بلاء» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:142-142.t: «ثلاثين»: a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the implied form is: "We appointed with him the completion of thirty". «ليلة» is a tamyīz (specification). «أربعين» is a mafʿūl bihi, on «تمَّ» being made to imply (taḍmīn) the meaning of بلغ (to reach). The clause «وقال موسى» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:143-143.t: «أنظرْ»: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it occurs as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied (muqaddar) condition, i.e. "if You show me, I will look". The clause «ولكن انظر» is conjoined to the clause «لن تراني», and the clause «فإن استقر مكانه» is conjoined to the clause «انظر»; «مكانه» is an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) «استقر». The clause «فلما تجلى» is resumptive, and «لما» is a particle of necessity for necessity (ḥarf wujūb li-wujūb). His words «صعقا»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «موسى». The clause «فلما أفاق» is conjoined to the clause «خَرَّ موسى». His words «سبحانه» [Translator's note: so in the source; the verse has «سبحانك»]: stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and what governs it is implied, i.e. "we glorify, Your glory". The clause «تبت إليك» is resumptive within the scope of the speech, and the clause «وأنا أول المؤمنين» is conjoined to the verbal clause «تبت», in the position of the nominative.

harrat-mujtaba:145-145.t: The preposition «من كل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «موعظة», and the preposition «بقوة» is attached to an implied (muqaddar) ḥāl from the fāʿil (agent), i.e. "involved in strength". «دار» is a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «يأخذوا» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e. "if you command your people, they will take". The clause «سأريكم» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. «دار» is a second mafʿūl bihi.

harrat-mujtaba:146-146.t: The preposition «بغير» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in «يتكبرون». «سبيلا» is a second object. The interpreted maṣdar «بأنهم كذَّبوا» is in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ, attached to the khabar (predicate). The clause «ذلك بأنهم» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:147-147.t: The clause «حبطت أعمالهم» is in the position of the nominative as a khabar (predicate). The clause «هل يجزون» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. «ما» is a relative noun, a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

harrat-mujtaba:148-148.t: The preposition «من بعده» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «اتخذ», and the preposition «من حليهم» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «عجلا». «عجلا» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «جسدًا» is a badal (substitute). The clause «له خوار» is a naʿt (adjective) of «جسداً». The interpreted maṣdar «أنه لا يكلمهم» is the object of «يروا», and «سبيلا» is a second object. The clause «اتخذوه» is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and the clause «كانوا» is a ḥāl from the wāw in «اتخذوه».

harrat-mujtaba:149-149.t: The preposition «في أيديهم» is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). The interpreted maṣdar «أنهم قد ضلُّوا» takes the place of the two objects of the cognitive (qalbiyya) «رأى». The clause «لنكوننَّ» is the answer to the oath, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the answer to the oath.

harrat-mujtaba:150-150.t: «غضبان أسفا»: two ḥāls (circumstantial) from Moses. His words «بئسما»: a past verb, and «ما» is a relative noun, fāʿil (agent); the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, i.e. "your succession". The clause «أعجلتم» is resumptive, and the clause «يجره» is a ḥāl from the fāʿil of «أخذ». «أُمَّ»: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with a kasra implied (muqaddar) on what precedes the yāʾ of the first person, which was changed into alif and then dropped. The clause «فلا تشمت» is conjoined to the answer to the vocative, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:151-151.t: The clause «وأنت أرحم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «أدخلنا».

harrat-mujtaba:152-152.t: The preposition «في الحياة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «ذِلَّة». The clause «نجزي» is resumptive, and the kāf stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "We recompense with a recompense like that recompense".

harrat-mujtaba:153-153.t: The preposition «من بعدها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «غفور», and [the lām is] the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa). The clause «إن ربك لغفور» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «الذين», and the referring pronoun is implied (muqaddar), i.e. "forgiving to them".

harrat-mujtaba:154-154.t: The clause «وفي نسختها هدى» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the tablets. His words «لربهم»: the lām is redundant (zāʾida), for strengthening, since the governor is weakened by coming later; «ربهم» is an object placed first.

harrat-mujtaba:155-155.t: «قومه»: accusative by removal of the preposition «مِنْ». «سبعين» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «رجلا» is a tamyīz (specification). The preposition «لميقاتنا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «اختار». The clause «فلما أخذتهم» is conjoined to «اختار». «رب»: the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, accusative with a fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on what precedes the dropped yāʾ, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). «وإياي»: the wāw is a conjunction, and «إيا» is a detached accusative pronoun conjoined to the hāʾ in «أهلكتهم», and the yāʾ is for the first person. The preposition «منا» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «السفهاء». «إنْ» is negating, then a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate), and «إلا» is for restriction. The clause «تضلُّ بها» is a ḥāl from «فتنتك». The clause «أنت ولينا» is resumptive within the scope of the speech. The clause «فاغفر لنا» is conjoined to the clause «أنت ولينا», in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:156-156.t: The preposition «في هذه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «حسنة», and «حسنة» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «اكتب». The preposition «في الآخرة» is conjoined to the preposition «في هذه», attached to «اكتب». The clause «وسعت» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «رحمتي», and the clause «فسأكتبها» is conjoined to the clause «وسعت», in the position of the nominative as a khabar.

harrat-mujtaba:157-157.t: «الذين يتبعون»: a badal (substitute) from the preceding relative noun. «النبي» is a badal from «الرسول»; «الأميّ» and «الذي» are two naʿts (adjectives) of النبي. «مكتوباً» is the second object of «يجد», and the adverb «عندهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مكتوبا», and likewise «في التوراة». The clause «يأمرهم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الرسول». «التي» is a naʿt of «الأغلال», in the position of the accusative. The clause «أولئك هم المفلحون» is in the position of the nominative as a khabar (predicate); «هم» is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:158-158.t: «الناس»: ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) from «أي». «جميعا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in «إليكم». The clause of tanzīh (affirming God's oneness) is a badal (substitute) from the ṣila (relative clause). «إلا» is for restriction, and «هو» is a badal from the latent (mustatir) pronoun in the omitted khabar (predicate). The clause «فآمنوا» is resumptive, and the clause «لعلكم تهتدون» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:159-159.t: The clause «يهدون» is a naʿt (adjective) of أمة. The preposition «به» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يعدلون».

harrat-mujtaba:160-160.t: «اثنتي»: a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative with yāʾ because it is treated like the dual; «عشرة» is a part [of the number], indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, with no grammatical position, and its tamyīz (specification) is omitted, i.e. "group". «أسباطا» is a badal (substitute) from the tamyīz; «أسباطاً» cannot be the tamyīz because it is a masculine plural. «أمما» is a badal from «أسباطا». «إذ» is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أوحينا». «أنْ» is explicative, and the clause «اضرب» is explicative. «اثنتا» is the fāʿil (agent), nominative with alif because it is treated like the dual; «عشرة» is a part, indeclinable on fatḥa, with no position, and «عينا» is a tamyīz. The clause «قد علم كل أناس» is a naʿt (adjective) of «اثنتا عشرة», and the link is omitted, i.e. "of them". The clause «كلوا» is the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl) of an implied (muqaddar) saying, i.e. "We said to them: eat". The clause «وما ظلمونا» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:161-161.t: «إذ»: an adverbial noun, the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being اذكر; the clause is resumptive. The nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of «قيل» is a pronoun referring to its maṣdar. «هذه» is a mafʿūl bihi, and «حيث» is an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. «حطة» is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "our request is relief". «سجَّدا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «ادخلوا». The clause «نغفر» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied (muqaddar) condition, with no grammatical position. The clause «سنزيد» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:162-162.t: The preposition «منهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the relative noun. «غير» is a naʿt (adjective) of «قولا», and the preposition «من السماء» is attached to a naʿt of «رجزا». The interpreted maṣdar «بما كانوا» is genitive, attached to «أرسلنا».

harrat-mujtaba:163-163.t: The clause «واسألهم» is conjoined to the implied (muqaddar) clause اذكر at the start of verse 161. «التي» is a naʿt (adjective) of the town. «إذ يعدون» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «حاضرة»; it is not attached to «اسألهم», because «إذ» is for what is past and «اسألهم» is future. «إذ تأتيهم» is an adverb attached to «يعدون». «شرَّعا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «حيتانهم». The adverb «يوم» is attached to «تأتيهم», i.e. "they do not come to them on the day they do not keep the Sabbath"; this shows that it is permitted to place what is governed by a verb negated with «لا» before «لا». The kāf in «كذلك» stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "We try them with a trial like that trial". The interpreted maṣdar «بما كانوا» is genitive, attached to «نبلوهم». The clause «نبلوهم» is resumptive, and the clause «كانوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative.

harrat-mujtaba:164-164.t: The wāw is a conjunction; «إذ» is an adverbial noun conjoined to (إِذْ) in verse 161. The preposition «منهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «أمة». «لِمَ»: the lām is a preposition, and «ما» is an interrogative noun in the position of the genitive, attached to «تعظون»; its alif was dropped for lightness. The clause «الله مهلكهم» is a naʿt of «قوماً». «عذابا» stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), what governs them [Translator's note: so in the source («عاملهم»); presumably "what governs it"] being «معذبهم». «معذرة»: a mafʿūl muṭlaq of an implied (muqaddar) verb. The clause «معذرة إلى ربكم» is the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl), in the position of the accusative, and the clause «ولعلهم يتقون» is conjoined to the content of the speech, in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:165-165.t: «لما» is a particle of necessity for necessity (ḥarf wujūb li-wujūb), and the interpreted maṣdar «بما كانوا» is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أخذنا».

harrat-mujtaba:166-166.t: The clause «فلما عتوا» is conjoined to {فَلَمَّا نَسُوا}. «خاسئين» is a second khabar (predicate) of «كونوا»; taking it as a naʿt (adjective) of «قردة» is weak, because this is the plural of rational beings.

harrat-mujtaba:167-167.t: The wāw is a conjunction, and «إذ» is the object of an implied (muqaddar) اذكر. «تَأذَّن» is treated as an oath, and the clause «ليبعثن» is the answer to the oath. «مَن» is a relative noun, the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «بعث», and «سوء» is the second object of «سام».

harrat-mujtaba:168-168.t: «أمما»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the object of «قطعناهم», and the clause «منهم الصالحون» is a naʿt (adjective) of «أمما». The preposition «ومنهم دون» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of an implied (muqaddar) mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "and of them are people below that"; «دون» is an adverb of place attached to a naʿt of an omitted qualified noun, which is the mubtadaʾ. The clause «ومنهم (ناس)» is conjoined to the clause «منهم الصالحون», in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:169-169.t: The clause «ورثوا» is a naʿt (adjective) of «خلف», and the clause «يأخذون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «ورثوا». «هذا» is a demonstrative, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and «الأدنى» is a badal (substitute), genitive. The nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of «سيُغفر» is a pronoun understood from the context of the speech, i.e. "what we did will be forgiven us". «مثله» is a naʿt, nominative. The clause «ألم يؤخذ» is resumptive, and the interpreted maṣdar «أن لا يقولوا» is a badal from «ميثاق»; «الحق» is the object of «يقولوا». «للذين يتقون» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خير».

harrat-mujtaba:170-170.t: The clause «إنا لا نضيع» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «الذين», and the link is the repetition of the mubtadaʾ in its meaning.

harrat-mujtaba:171-171.t: The clause «كأنه ظلة» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الجبل», in the position of the accusative. The interpreted maṣdar «أنه واقع» takes the place of the two objects of «ظنَّ». The clause «خذوا» is the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl) of an omitted saying, i.e. "and We said: take"; the implied clause of saying is conjoined to the clause «نتقنا». The clause «لعلكم تتقون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:172-172.t: The preposition «من ظهورهم» is a badal (substitute) from «من بني». The clause «ألست بربكم» is the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl) of an implied (muqaddar) saying, i.e. "He said: am I not", and the implied saying is a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "saying". The clause «بلى (أنت ربنا)» is the content of the speech, and the clause «شهدنا» is resumptive. The interpreted maṣdar «أن تقولوا» is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. "out of aversion".

harrat-mujtaba:173-173.t: The clause «وكنا ذرية» is conjoined to the clause «أشرك», in the position of the accusative. The clause «أفتهلكنا» is conjoined to the clause «كنا», in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:174-174.t: (وكذلك نفصل الآيات) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The kāf stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "We detail with a detailing like that detailing", and the clause «نفصِّل» is resumptive. The clause «ولعلهم يرجعون» is conjoined to an implied (muqaddar) resumptive clause, i.e. "so that they may reflect, and so that they may return".

harrat-mujtaba:175-175.t: The clause «واتل» is resumptive. The clause «فانسلخ» is conjoined to the clause «آتيناه», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:176-176.t: The clause «ولكنه أخلد» is conjoined to «شئنا», and the clause «فمثله كمثل» is conjoined to «اتبع». The conditional clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الكلب». The clause «أو تتركه يلهث» is conjoined to the conditional clause. His words «أو تتركه يلهث»: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), conjoined to the clause «تحمل», and «يلهث» is an imperfect verb, jussive, conjoined to the first «يلهث». «القصص» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause «فاقصص» is resumptive. The clause «لعلهم يتفكرون» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:177-177.t: His words «ساء مثلا»: a past verb meaning بئس (how evil), and its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun explained by the tamyīz (specification) «مثلا». «القوم» is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "they are the people". «أنفسهم» is an object placed before «يظلمون». The clause «هم القوم» explains the clause of blame, and the clause «كانوا» is conjoined to the clause «كذَّبوا».

harrat-mujtaba:178-178.t: «من»: a conditional noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). His words «هم الخاسرون»: «هم» is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position, and «والخاسرون» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «أولئك».

harrat-mujtaba:179-179.t: The clause «لقد ذرأنا» is the answer to the oath. The preposition «من الجن» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «كثيرا». The clause «لهم قلوب» is a naʿt of «كثيرا», and the clause «لا يفقهون بها» is a naʿt of «قلوب». The clause «ولهم أعين» is conjoined to the clause «لهم قلوب». The clause «أولئك كالأنعام» is resumptive, and likewise «بل هم أضل».

harrat-mujtaba:180-180.t: The clause «فادعوه بها» is conjoined to the clause «لله الأسماء». The clause «سيجزون» is resumptive, with no grammatical position; «ما» is a relative noun, a second object.

harrat-mujtaba:181-181.t: The clause «يهدون» is a naʿt (adjective) of «أمة», and the preposition «به» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يعدلون».

harrat-mujtaba:182-182.t: «حيث»: an adverbial noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before it; the clause «لا يعلمون» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

harrat-mujtaba:183-183.t: The clause «إن كيدي متين» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:184-184.t: (ما بصاحبهم من جنة) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] «ما» is negating; the preposition «بصاحبهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate), «جنة» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and «مِن» is redundant (zāʾida). The clause is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), on «يتفكروا» being made to imply (taḍmīn) the meaning of a transitive cognitive verb, namely «يعلموا»; «يتفكروا» is not transitive by itself but only through «في», and there is no clause [that can be] in the terminology of "removal of the preposition". «إنْ» is negating, «نذير» is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and the clause is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:185-185.t: His words «وما خلق الله من شيء»: the relative noun is conjoined to «ملكوت», in the position of the genitive, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «ما». His words «وأن عسى»: «أن» is lightened from the heavy (inna), and its noun is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn); «عسى» is a complete (tāmm) past verb; «أن» makes accusative; «يكون» is an imperfect abrogating verb (nāsikh) whose noun is the pronoun of the matter. The interpreted maṣdar «وأن عسى» is conjoined to «ما», and the interpreted maṣdar «أن يكون» is the fāʿil (agent) of عسى; the clause «عسى» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative, and the clause «عسى أن يكون» is the khabar (predicate) of the first «أن». The clause «قد اقترب أجلهم» is the khabar of «يكون»; the reading "يكون أجلهم قد اقترب" is weak, because the khabar is not placed first in our saying «زيد قام». The adverb after it is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «حديث».

harrat-mujtaba:186-186.t: «من»: a conditional noun, an object placed first. The preposition «له» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of «لا». The clause «ويذرهم» is resumptive, and the clause «يعمهون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the object of «يذرهم».

harrat-mujtaba:187-187.t: His words «أيان مرساها»: an interrogative noun, an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) a khabar (predicate) placed first, and «مرساها» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) placed later; the clause «أيان مرساها» is a badal (substitute) of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) from «الساعة», in the position of the genitive. The clause «لا يجلِّيها لوقتها إلا هو» is resumptive within the scope of the speech, and likewise the clauses «ثقلت», «لا تأتيكم» and «يسألونك». «هو» is the fāʿil (agent) of «يجلِّيها», and «إلا» is for restriction. «بغتة» is a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of a ḥāl (circumstantial). The clause «كأنك حفيٌّ» is a ḥāl from the wāw in «يسألونك», and the clause «ولكن أكثر..» is conjoined to the clause that is the content of the speech.

harrat-mujtaba:188-188.t: «ما»: a relative noun, excepted, connected (muttaṣil). The conditional clause is conjoined to the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl). The clause «وما مسَّني السوء» is conjoined to the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), with no grammatical position. The clause «إن أنا إلا نذير» is resumptive within the scope of the speech, in the position of the accusative; «إن» is negating and «إلا» is for restriction.

harrat-mujtaba:189-189.t: The conditional clause «لما تغشاها» is conjoined to the clause «جعل», with no grammatical position. «حملا» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), because it is the fetus itself. «صالحا» is a second object. The clause «لئن آتيتنا» explains the supplication. The clause «لنكونن» is the answer to the oath, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:190-190.t: The preposition «له» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied (muqaddar) second object. The clause «فتعالى الله» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:191-191.t: The relative noun «ما» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause «وهم يخلقون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial), in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:192-192.t: The preposition «لهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «نصرا». «أنفسهم» is an object placed first.

harrat-mujtaba:193-193.t: «سواء»: a khabar (predicate) placed first, and the preposition «عليكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the maṣdar «سواء»; the verb together with the hamza of equalisation (taswiya) has the force of a maṣdar, a mubtadaʾ (subject) placed later. «أم» is a conjunction. The clause «وإن تدعوهم» is conjoined to the clause «ينصرون». The clause «أدعوتموهم» is resumptive, and the clause «أم أنتم صامتون» is conjoined to the resumptive clause, with no grammatical position, as a case of conjoining a nominal clause to a verbal one, because it has its meaning, i.e. "or you kept silent".

harrat-mujtaba:194-194.t: «أمثالكم»: a naʿt (adjective); it gained no definiteness from the annexation because it is utterly vague, and therefore an indefinite noun may be qualified by it. The clause «فادعوهم» is conjoined to the resumptive clause. The clause «فليستجيبوا» is conjoined to the clause «فادعوهم», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:195-195.t: «أم لهم أيد»: «أم» is a particle of digression (iḍrāb) meaning "rather" plus the hamza. «أيد» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative with a ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the dropped yāʾ. The clause «أم لهم أيد» is resumptive, and likewise the clauses after «أم». «كيدون»: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), the nūn is for protection (al-wiqāya), and the implied yāʾ is the object of the verb. «فلا تنظرون»: the fāʾ is a conjunction, «لا» is prohibitive, and the verb is jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, the nūn is for protection, and the implied yāʾ is the object of the verb.

harrat-mujtaba:196-196.t: «وليي»: the noun of inna, accusative with a fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on what precedes the yāʾ, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause «وهو يتولى» is conjoined to the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:197-197.t: The preposition «من دونه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the relative noun. The clause «لا يستطيعون» is the khabar (predicate) of the relative noun.

harrat-mujtaba:198-198.t: The clause «ينظرون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the object of «تراهم». The clause «وهم لا يبصرون» is a ḥāl from the wāw in «ينظرون».

harrat-mujtaba:200-200.t: His words «وإما ينزغنك»: the wāw is a conjunction, «إن» is conditional, «ما» is redundant (zāʾida), and an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of the jussive, with the nūn for emphasis. The clause «وإمَّا ينزغنَّك» is conjoined to the clause (أَعْرِضْ). The preposition «من الشيطان» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «نزغ».

harrat-mujtaba:201-201.t: The preposition «من الشيطان» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «طائف». «فإذا هم»: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «إذا» is of surprise (fujāʾiyya); «هم مبصرون» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate), and the clause is conjoined to the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:202-202.t: The clause «لا يُقْصِرون» is conjoined to the clause «يمدونهم».

harrat-mujtaba:203-203.t: «لولا»: a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ). «إنما» is a restraining particle and the restrained one (kāffa wa-makfūfa). The preposition «إليَّ» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يوحى», and the preposition «من ربي» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the latent (mustatir) nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). The clause «هذا بصائر» is resumptive within the scope of the speech, in the position of the accusative. The preposition «لقوم» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «رحمة».

harrat-mujtaba:204-204.t: The clause «لعلكم ترحمون» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:205-205.t: The preposition «في نفسك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the second-person pronoun in «ربك». «تَضَرُّعا» is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). «دون» is an adverb of place attached to a ḥāl conjoined to the first ḥāl, i.e. "being within yourself, and being below loudness". «من القول» is attached to a ḥāl from «الجهر». The preposition «بالغدو» is attached to «اذكر» at the start of the verse. The clause «ولا تكن» is conjoined to the clause «اذكر».

harrat-mujtaba:206-206.t: The clause «وله يسجدون» is conjoined to the clause «لا يستكبرون», in the position of the nominative.
